name: Zacess High Contrast Light
description: Black on white with strong dark borders and focus outlines, for the highest contrast on a light screen.
toml:
# the Zacess High Contrast Light theme as a profile, one of the ten starter profiles
# colours from the Zacess themes palette 0.12.1

spec_version = 1
name = "Zacess High Contrast Light"
id = "zacess-high-contrast-light"
description = "Black on white with strong dark borders and focus outlines, for the highest contrast on a light screen."
appearance = "light"

[needs]
reduce_motion = true
cursor_size = "standard"
focus_ring_width_px = 2

[needs.contrast]
text = 7.0
non_text = 3.0
overlay = 4.5
terminal = 7.0
terminal_dim = 4.5
highlight_distance = 0.08
colour_vision_distance = 0.04
tone_difference = 0.05

[needs.font]
family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"
fallback = "monospace"
size_pt = 14

[palette]
background = "#ffffff"
foreground = "#000000"
surface = "#f7f7f7"
surface_alt = "#efefef"
muted = "#2e2e2e"
border = "#262626"
accent = "#003d99"
accent_foreground = "#ffffff"
link = "#003d99"
focus_ring = "#003d99"
cursor = "#000000"
cursor_text = "#ffffff"
selection_background = "#015f5e"
selection_foreground = "#ffffff"
selection_soft = "#00d3d0"
line_highlight = "#c3e5fe"
error = "#8b0000"
# was #5a3a00, which matched the error colour in tone and merged with it under simulated colour
# vision deficiencies; this burnt orange is the most colourful shade that keeps them apart at 7:1
warning = "#4e1c00"
info = "#00337f"

[palette.syntax]
keyword = "#4b0091"
control = "#8a0046"
function = "#00347f"
type = "#004f4e"
variable = "#000000"
parameter = "#6b3100"
property = "#1e0090"
string = "#005518"
number = "#521e00"
comment = "#1701fb"
operator = "#000000"
tag = "#4b0091"
attribute = "#4f3200"
regex = "#720030"
invalid = "#600000"
added = "#005518"
removed = "#4a0000"
changed = "#00307a"

[palette.terminal]
ansi = [
    "#000000", "#ca0000", "#017424", "#875b00",
    "#005bdc", "#b400ac", "#006f6e", "#3d3d3d",
    "#333333", "#e90100", "#018726", "#9c6a01",
    "#016eee", "#cf00c6", "#028181", "#000000",
]
dim = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]

check.output:
pass profiles/zacess-high-contrast-light.toml (Zacess High Contrast Light)
     224 pairs against text 7:1, non-text 3:1, overlay 4.5:1, terminal 7:1 and dim terminal 4.5:1, with paired colours 0.05 apart in tone and 0.04 under colour vision deficiencies
     tightest syntax.comment #1701fb on selection_soft #00d3d0: 4.61:1
